name: @geoalgeria/normalize
description: Search-key generation for Algerian place names, in Arabic and in French. A zero-dependency, host-independent conservative key (presentation forms, alef and hamza variants, tatweel, harakat, Arabic-Indic digits, Latin accents, separator variants, case), a loose key (alef maqsura with yaa, taa marbuta with haa), a tokenizer and its golden corpus, so every GeoAlgeria index agrees character for character.
author: Yasser's Studio (https://yasser.studio)
